description: This file defines the PdfImageTable class and its nested ImageSelector class, which manage the collection of image resources within a PDF document, including mechanisms for identifying, hashing, and caching images.

classes.name: PdfImageTable
classes.description: Manages all images used in a PDF document, providing methods to retrieve and cache images based on their source and characteristics.

classes.name: PdfImageTable.ImageSelector
classes.description: A helper class used as a key to identify images uniquely based on hashing techniques, file paths, or GUIDs.

methods.name: GetImage
methods.description: Returns a PdfImage associated with an XImage, creating a new one if necessary and caching it.

methods.name: ImageSelector
methods.description: Constructs a unique identifier for an image based on its source stream, path, or imported image data, utilizing hashing and GUIDs.

methods.name: GetHashCreator
methods.description: Produces a HashAlgorithm instance (SHA1) used to compute hashes of image data for identification.

methods.name: GetHashSelectorPrefix
methods.description: Generates a string prefix based on image dimensions to help form unique selectors.

methods.name: HashToString
methods.description: Converts a byte array hash into a hex string representation.
